body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> IVS(www.penandmouse.co.kr) unveiled its wireless optical pen-type mouse 'P&M' at the 2009 International CES.

The P&M integrates a laser pointer, a pen and a 2.4GHz optical mouse in a single device, which is suitable for use in lectures, presentations and even to write down notes. It features its attached LED flash lights, scroll wheel function to be used up/down the page with one touch and presentation mode.

This digital pen-mouse operates at a range of up to 10m. Comeing with a rechargeable battery, it provides up to 10 hours operating time or up to 10 days standby time. Measuring 146x13.8x14.8mm at 24g, it is available in black, silver, blue and pink.
